description: Restore the LTXDirector pipeline in ltx23_director_mv_30s.py by: (1) fixing the git clone URL for WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI, (2) adding its requirements install, (3) restoring the build_timeline_data function, (4) restoring multi-image upload, (5) replacing the standard-node workaround in Step 8 with the real LTXDirector node call, (6) restoring LTXDirectorGuide nodes for Steps 11 and 21, (7) restoring LTXDirectorCropGuides for Steps 19 and 28. Keep all other fixes (model_download always returns filename, upload functions write bytes directly, sequential LoraLoader, no ModelPreviewOverrideKJ).
steps: In the custom_nodes setup section (~lines 40-53), replace the two comment lines ('# NOTE: rgthree-comfy no longer needed...' and '# NOTE: whatdreamscost-comfyui no longer needed...') with: '!git clone https://github.com/WhatDreamscost/WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI.git'. Then add after the VideoHelperSuite requirements install: '# %cd /content/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI\n!pip install -r requirements.txt'

Change upload_multiple_images() back to accept count=5 (not count=1) and update its docstring to say 'Upload multiple images for timeline segments' instead of 'Upload reference image(s) for video conditioning'
In Cell 4 (Media Upload), change the upload_multiple_images call from count=1 to count=5, and update the markdown comments to reference timeline segments (not just 'first image')

The clip should be get_value_at_index(powerloraloaderrgthree_138, 1).

Replace Step 10 (LTXVConditioning) to use get_value_at_index(ltxdirector_131, 6) for frame_rate and get_value_at_index(ltxdirector_131, 1) for positive
